instruction: A lightweight pedestrian footbridge: a flat walkway deck spanning between two abutments, side railings, and a truss or beam structure underneath/along the sides that makes real structural sense. Meter units, aligned to a local origin.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a pedestrian footbridge. A lightweight pedestrian footbridge: a flat walkway deck spanning between two abutments, side railings, and a truss or beam structure underneath/along the sides that makes real structural sense. Meter units, aligned to a local origin. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
